answers.reason: As a member of the central university leadership, the vice president for studies takes part in the central body that decides university-wide strategy and structure.
Budget planning is the responsibility of the chancellor and the vice president does not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
Appointments are separate from study matters, and members do not sit in bodies that deal with other kinds of questions.
The faculty council handles the affairs of a single faculty, whereas the vice president operates at the central university level.
The study commission prepares changes to degree programmes and advises on teaching, which matches the vice president's responsibility for degree programmes and quality of teaching.
The examination board decides on examination matters, which falls directly under the vice president's responsibility for examinations.
Internal research funding is a faculty-level research matter unrelated to the vice president's focus on studies and teaching.
Rewriting module descriptions for a single degree programme is a local working task, and members only take part in the one place where their university-wide matters are decided.
Decisions about laboratory equipment have no bearing on study programmes, and members do not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
Planning the orientation week for new students is an operational matter separate from the formal responsibility for degree programmes, examinations, and teaching quality.
